operatorCorrelatedSequence.action: Synapse Plugged In lighting was set to Brightness On, slider 50, Quick Effect Static, and logo Static.
OpenBlade was installed and started while its prior OpenBlade-owned lighting profile still requested Off.
operatorCorrelatedSequence.interpretation: The Synapse page still displayed On/50/Static, proving that visible cached UI alone was not current firmware state.

operatorCorrelatedSequence.action: The visible OpenBlade switch was enabled for Windows Dynamic Lighting ownership.

openBladeUi.status: Windows Dynamic Lighting owns the keyboard. OpenBlade will not change keyboard brightness, effects, or lighting power policies.

operatorCorrelatedSequence.action: Synapse brightness was deliberately toggled Off and then On to reapply the visible 50 percent Static state after delegation.
The OpenBlade Windows service was restarted and reached Running/Automatic.

limitations: This validates OpenBlade's persisted service-side write suppression and a Static 50 percent state across one service restart.
It does not claim that Synapse or Windows issued a particular packet during the ownership toggle.
No raw packet capture, serial number, device path, or unique USB identifier is retained.
